history.recommendation_text: The Board also recommends that the Administration review in the coming months, through a process including all stakeholders, the quality of the existing “risk registers” and “risk treatment and response plans”.
history.administration_response: The Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance will continue to engage with the relevant stakeholders, namely, the Department of Peace Operations and the Department of Operational Support, and all the peacekeeping missions to improve the quality of risk registers. An implementation schedule is being prepared to outline the planned sequence for reviewing entities, starting in the third quarter of 2024. In addition, the gradual adoption of the Umoja enterprise risk management module itself across all peacekeeping operations will enhance alignment with the policy and methodology, consistency and quality of the registers. Its deployment across all peacekeeping operations by 31 December 2024 is already greatly strengthening the alignment with the overall policy and methodology.
history.board_assessment: The Board notes the efforts to improve the risk registers and of the progress to be expected from the Umoja enterprise risk management module’s implementation. Once these projects are finalized, the recommendation will be considered implemented.
